correctness.rationale: The current package uses the wrong Fourier exponent on the root edge rc: it uses g1+g2, whereas for a consistent four-leaf pattern the rooted edge carries g1+g2+g3=g4 in G=Z2xZ2. The current verifier therefore certifies the wrong polynomial map. Recomputing the corrected map exactly nevertheless preserves the decisive conclusion: the 64x19 Jacobian has rank 13, with a nonzero 13x13 minor of determinant 160576479/4194304; the displayed-tree monomial exponent matrix has rank 10. The result is repairable, but the uncorrected research files are not internally correct.

originality.rationale: Recent dimension theory leaves the even-order 3-cycle case open. Cox, Gross, and Martin prove their 3-sunlet dimension formula for odd-order abelian groups and explicitly explain that even-order groups remain unresolved under their method. K2P uses the even-order group Z2xZ2, so an exact certified lower bound for this concrete triangle-network model is not mechanically implied by that theorem.

scientific_value.rationale: After correcting the root-edge exponent, the rank-13 certificate rigorously refutes the proposed dimension 7 in a genuinely delicate 3-cycle/even-order regime and also fixes the displayed-tree dimension at 10. This is useful algebraic-statistical information for identifiability and parameter-count questions even though the exact network dimension is not yet proved.
